analyst_view.overall: Early view: Como play this four days before a Champions League trip to Real Betis, so Fabregas may rotate. Monza had lost four in a row before the break and play Fiorentina and Roma before this, so they could arrive in serious trouble; Juric was sent off against Atalanta. Monza still have the league's top scorer in Gustavo Varela, and they had the better of the first half against Atalanta.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Monza's home games have averaged 3.6 goals and Como's away games about 3.2, so the number is fair. Como are far more open away than at home, and Monza attack even when they are struggling.

corners.text: The site expects 8.5 corners. I lean higher: Como's away games have averaged about 11 corners, with Como winning six a game themselves. Monza's home games have averaged about eight, so this is a moderate lean.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. I lean lower because Como are one of the least-booked teams in Serie A at about one a game, and their away games have averaged under three cards. Monza's home games have averaged about 3.6.

shots.text: The site expects 26.3 shots. I lean higher: Como's away games have averaged about 33 shots and Monza's home games about 31. Monza took 22 shots against Atalanta and will go for it at home.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. I lean higher because Monza's home games have averaged over 12 on target and Como's away games about ten. Monza's open style and Varela's finishing produce plenty of shots on target at both ends.
